outgoingFlows.description: S to E infection flow driven by infectious individuals; corresponds to c * S * I / N, with contact rate modified by NPIs
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate epsilon = 1 / incubation period
Removal from transmission at rate r; in the paper Removed includes recovery and effective isolation/detection

parameters.name: N
parameters.description: Approximate total mainland China population represented in the aggregated SEIR abstraction

parameters.name: R0
parameters.description: Baseline reproduction number used by the paper for the early Wuhan outbreak

parameters.name: incubationPeriod
parameters.description: Average incubation period from the paper

parameters.name: epsilon
parameters.description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious

parameters.name: infectiousPeriod
parameters.description: Average infectious period proxy based on onset-to-isolation timing used before strong interventions

parameters.name: baseRemovalRate
parameters.description: Baseline removal/isolation rate before time-varying improvements

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Effective removal rate under NPIs; higher values represent earlier detection and isolation

parameters.name: baseContactRate
parameters.description: Baseline daily contact-transmission rate c derived from R0 divided by infectious period, following the paper

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Effective contact rate under NPIs and social distancing

parameters.name: mobilityRestrictionMultiplier
parameters.description: Inter-city mobility scaling factor retained for semantic fidelity to the paper's travel network layer; 1 means no extra scaling in this single-population abstraction

parameters.name: contactReductionMultiplier
parameters.description: Scales transmission-relevant contacts under social distancing; values below 1 represent contact reduction

parameters.name: detectionIsolationMultiplier
parameters.description: Scales removal rate under improved case detection and isolation; values above 1 represent faster removal from transmission

parameters.name: initialSeed
parameters.description: Initial infected individuals in Wuhan used by the paper on December 1, 2019
